rationale: All five original findings resolved. CR-001 and CR-002: disabled and isLoading state tests added for magical button — opacity-50/cursor-not-allowed and cursor-wait/shimmer overlay verified, 8/8 tests green. CR-003: variant prop path covered by two tests exercising variant='magical'. CR-004: action-accent-hover decoupled from purple-radial-hover to its own hardcoded linear-gradient, no unintended side-effect remains. CR-005: branch rebased onto origin/main, only two EPMCDME-8512 conforming commits remain ahead of origin/main.

standards_review.notes: Both commits ahead of origin/main match 'EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence' format. No merge-from-origin commits remain.
Changes are limited to Button.tsx (styling classes), Button.test.tsx, and tailwind.config.ts. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no redirects, no secrets.

finding_status.notes: Test 'applies disabled styling on a magical button' added. Renders <Button type="magical" disabled> and asserts bg-magical-button, opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed, and button.toBeDisabled(). Test passes.

Test 'applies loading styling on a magical button' added. Renders <Button type="magical" isLoading> and asserts bg-magical-button, cursor-wait, button.toBeDisabled(), and shimmer overlay (.animate-shimmer) present. Test passes.

Two tests added: 'applies magical classes when variant="magical"' and 'variant prop takes precedence over type prop'. Both assert bg-magical-button, text-text-inverse, hover:brightness-90 and the variant path through displayType = variant ?? type. Tests pass.

tailwind.config.ts line 621: action-accent-hover changed from 'var(--backgroundImage-purple-radial-hover)' to 'linear-gradient(90deg, #672D92 0%, #5677C8 100%)'. The ACTION button hover gradient now has its own value independent of purple-radial-hover. The magical button gradient change is no longer an unguarded side-effect.

Branch rebased. 'git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD' shows only two commits: '317770591 EPMCDME-8512: Add variant prop coverage and decouple action-accent-hover gradient' and '352b7c730 EPMCDME-8512: Fix WCAG 1.4.3 contrast on magical button'. No merge-from-origin commits remain.
